children: Jain takes on the new role after serving as Vice President and Business Head, marking another leadership milestone in his seven-year journey with the brand
Spykar Lifestyles has elevated Gautam Jain to Chief Business Officer (CBO).
Jain shared the development in a LinkedIn post. He was previously serving as Vice President and Business Head at Spykar, a role he held from October 2025 to September 2026.

Jain has been associated with Spykar for over seven years, having joined the company in June 2019. In April 2022, he was elevated to Associate Vice President and Business Head, overseeing LFR and Spykar Woman. He moved into the Vice President and Business Head role in October 2025.
Before joining Spykar, Jain worked as Category Manager for Men’s Youth at Central, part of Future Lifestyle Fashion.

Earlier, he spent over seven years at Shoppers Stop as Senior Manager – Buying and Merchandising, handling men’s jeanswear and casual fashion. He began his career at J.K. Fabrics Bangalore, where he worked as Senior Merchandiser for nearly seven years, from January 2004 to November 2010.
Jain holds an MBA in Marketing from ICFAI Business School and a Bachelor of Commerce degree from the University of Mumbai.
